test_cases.name: Verbose Quote Request for Multiple Items
test_cases.description: A verbose customer requests a quote for several catalog items, providing extra context and details in a neutral, professional tone.

initial_turn.subject: Request for Quote on Several Items
initial_turn.body:
Hello,

I hope this message finds you well. I am reaching out to request a formal quote for a selection of products that we are considering for an upcoming project. We are in the process of evaluating several options for a community event, and I want to ensure we have accurate pricing and availability information before making any decisions. Please include any relevant details such as lead times, bulk discounts, or special terms if applicable.

The items we are interested in are as follows:

- 2 units of the WonderWagon Electric Train. This will be used as a centerpiece for our children's activity area, so please confirm if there are any accessory options or recommended add-ons.
- 5 T-Shirts. We are looking for a mix of sizes and possibly colors, but for now, please quote for 'T-Shirt' as listed in your catalog. If you need more specifics, let me know what information is required.
- 1 Rasta Coffee Grinder, as we plan to set up a small coffee station for volunteers.
- 3 units of Pizza (please use the catalog item that is most commonly ordered for events, as I noticed there are several pizza listings).

If you require any further information to prepare the quote, please let me know. Thank you in advance for your assistance, and I look forward to your response.

Best regards,
Tom Martinez (Home)

test_cases.name: Verbose Quote Request for Multiple Items
test_cases.description: A detailed and polite email from German Bakery requesting a quote for several catalog items, with ample context and explanations.

initial_turn.subject: Request for Detailed Quote on Selected Products
initial_turn.body:
Dear Sales Team,

I hope this message finds you well. My name is Anna from German Bakery, and we are currently in the process of evaluating new suppliers for some of our upcoming product lines and in-store needs. To assist us in our planning and budgeting, I would appreciate it if you could provide a detailed quote for the following items from your catalog:

1. WonderWash Washing Machine – We are interested in understanding the pricing for a single unit, as we are considering upgrading our current laundry equipment. Please include any relevant details regarding warranty and delivery options if possible.
2. T-Shirt – We noticed you offer several T-Shirt options (AITEM-0022, AITEM-0023, AITEM-0024, AITEM-0025). Could you please quote us for 10 pieces of your T-Shirt? We are particularly interested in the quality and sizing, as these may be used for staff uniforms, but we are not certain which specific model would be most suitable. Any additional information or recommendations would be appreciated.
3. Organic Carrot – Please include pricing for 20 kg, as we are exploring organic produce options for our bakery’s daily menu.

If you require any further information or clarification regarding our request, please do not hesitate to reach out. We look forward to receiving your detailed quote at your earliest convenience.

Best regards,
German Bakery
